notes: A bug fix in Claude hook attribution (SubagentStops from agents that never started, with agent_type "", were attributed to the root agent and ended its turn) is tested only with hand-built payloads, justified as keeping each case readable. The shape it fixes is recorded: fixtures/claude/subagent.jsonl and compaction.jsonl hold exactly these SubagentStops (docs/protocols/claude.md finding 6), and TEST-no-fixture requires adapter tests to replay fixtures/<provider>/*.jsonl where one exists and a bug fix to come with a fixture that reproduces it. Everything else holds: attribution never throws or drops a payload (non-string ids fall back to the root agent), the code sits in apps/server/src/providers/claude/, and no test spawns a CLI.
